subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `captionedFinalText` as a public channel capability and make Telegram final-mode TTS use captioned voice delivery by default after the failure-path bug is fixed?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but the PR expands the plugin SDK capability surface and changes default Telegram delivery behavior for existing TTS users, which requires maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Merge the capability-gated design after the direct ACP async-failure fallback is fixed and focused tests cover both routed and direct delivery.

options.title: Keep old default
options.body: Leave Telegram final-mode TTS as separate visible text plus voice for now and track captioned delivery as a configurable or later API decision.

options.title: Narrow to internal Telegram
options.body: Avoid a public SDK capability in this PR and solve only the bundled Telegram path until the plugin contract is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Merge the capability-gated design after the direct ACP async-failure fallback is fixed and focused tests cover both routed and direct delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history points to steipete on the implicated dispatch/channel files, and the decision spans core dispatch plus Telegram channel behavior.
